ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark pigments to high-intensity light pigments across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) contiguous background with high-intensity (creamy white) linear streaks and irregular mottling concentrated in the medial regions of both lobes, transitioning to solid dark intensity at the lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and high vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with vertical pixel-amplitude variations of 10-30 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) representing barnacle attachment points, distributed across the central fluke and heavily concentrated on the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, light-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the primary dark pigmentation, with a high-density cluster in the lower-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring across the mid-surface; barnacle colonization present on the extreme lateral tips of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique intersecting linear scars forming a distinct cross-hatch or 'X' pattern in the lower-left lobe region.
